title: Sorry
label: ch:ta-sorry
canDo: I can apologise with மன்னிக்கவும் where its register fits, and say plainly where colloquial Tamil varies by region instead of pretending one form is standard.

payoff.summary: Say maṉ-ṉi-kkavum holding both doubled consonants, use it for a considered apology, and qualify the casual alternatives rather than asserting one.
